title: Verniman method: auction, order flow and execution knowledge base
summary: A source-backed method library covering 27 blog topics, plus local Daily Map archives for all of 2025 and January 1–October 30, 2026 with dated text/image records and explicit gaps.
data_summary: Method review: 27 pages, 46 videos, 42 retained caption exports. Daily Map 2026: 201 maps, 198 dated days, two undated commentaries, 417 images. Daily Map 2025: 246 maps, 242 dated days, 492 image references. All 668 calendar dates recorded; no market-data calculations.
evidence_status: Qualitative source research and local source preservation. Method media gaps remain. Both annual archives preserve 19 weekday gaps; 2026 has three duplicate date pairs, one historical recovery and two inline image fallbacks; 2025 has four duplicate pairs and no request failures. No trading validation.
